items.title: A six term exact sequence for the naive cotangent complex of a composition of ring maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a canonical map from the base change of the naive cotangent complex of an intermediate ring to the shift of the cone of the map between the outer two complexes, and derives from it a six term exact sequence of cohomology sheaves (author lemma at source lines 6002-6031, label lemma-exact-sequence-NL). The proof (source lines 6033-6061) constructs the map by the cone criterion, giving the first component by functoriality and writing down an explicit homotopy on generators, and then reduces the resulting exactness statement to the algebraic statement of the same shape by checking on stalks (proof lines 6044-6059). The explicit homotopy and the reduction to stalks are the content; the author closes with the remark that some details are omitted. H3.
